clause: Alignment + container vertical justification + full H&J record [STU-TYP-034,STU-TYP-035]

scope.summary: Alignment MUST cover left/center/right (horizontal), top/center/bottom (vertical/CJK), and container-level vertical justification (top/middle/bottom/justified) as a property of the area container (not the paragraph) so it survives paragraph edits. Full H&J: the justification record stores minimum/desired/maximum percentages for word spacing, letter spacing, and glyph scaling; an auto-leading percentage; and a single-word-justification policy. The composer consumes these ranges to place break points; identical inputs MUST yield identical breaks across hosts ([STU-TYP-008]).
expected_tests: live: horizontal + vertical/CJK alignment; container vertical justification survives paragraph edit
test: H&J min/desired/max word+letter+glyph-scale ranges drive deterministic breaks cross-host
acceptance_criteria_original: H/V + CJK alignment; container vertical justification; full H&J range record; cross-host identical breaks

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-TYP-034] Alignment MUST cover left/center/right for horizontal text, top/center/bottom for vertical/CJK text, and container-level vertical justification (top/middle/bottom/justified) as a property of the `area` container rather than the paragraph, so vertical justification survives paragraph edits (provenance: Affinity text-frame vertical justification).

[STU-TYP-035] Full H&J: the justification record MUST store minimum / desired / maximum percentages for word spacing, letter spacing, and glyph scaling; an auto-leading percentage; and a single-word-justification policy (full-justify / align-left / align-center / align-right for a lone word on a line). The composer consumes these ranges to place break points; identical inputs MUST yield identical breaks across hosts ([STU-TYP-008]).

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
